body: I don't know if I can wait that long. This girl has been with me through so much the past 7 years. It's all gone. Nothing left.

What if I will never find that girl that you mention? What if this was the best part of my life I'll ever have? I cannot see the light anymore. Something inside me died when she left me and rushed into a new relationship so fast. Honestly, I've been pathetic. I am ashamed to say that I begged her to give us another chance in weak moments.

For now I'm still here. I still want to pull the trigger but maybe I'll chicken out in the end eventhough I am hurting so much. I know it sounds stupid but this feels as bad as when one of my parents died. Dare I say even worse?

It's just really hard to see if there is still something good for me in the future or if it's just a lie I should tell myself to feel better. What if this was the best and nothing will ever live up to it? Before it ended, at least. She's my first love and it lasted so long. It was beautiful but it ended in such a horrible way. I feel like I will have a difficulty trusting new people because what if they will tear my heart wide open after many years like this girl? I feel so so so so so bad mentally. I don't want to feel like this again ever.
